The '''Search for the Valley of the Jedi''' was a quest undertaken by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jan Ors]], who fought to prevent the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and former [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] from gaining control of the power of the [[Valley of the Jedi]], an ancient burial ground located on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]].
